paper.title: Informer: Beyond Efficient Transformer for Long Sequence Time-Series Forecasting
paper.abstract: Many real-world applications require the prediction of long sequence time-series, such as electricity consumption planning. Long sequence time-series forecasting demands a high prediction capacity. In this paper, we propose Informer to address these issues with ProbSparse self-attention mechanism. Extensive experiments on four large-scale datasets demonstrate that Informer significantly outperforms existing methods.
